mapper.select: select * from integration_schema.job_run where run_id=#{runId} for update
select * from integration_schema.job_run where job_code=#{jobCode} and xxl_job_id=#{jobId} and xxl_log_key=#{logKey} and xxl_shard_index=#{shardIndex} for update

select r.* from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) where d.resource_key=#{resourceKey} and r.status in ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') and r.run_id != #{excludedRun} order by r.created_at limit 1
select r.*,d.resource_key,d.enabled from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) where r.run_id=#{runId} for update of r

select r.*,d.resource_key from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) join integration_schema.job_lease l on l.resource_key=d.resource_key where r.job_code=#{jobCode} and r.trigger_type='XXL' and ( (r.status='PENDING' and r.created_at<clock_timestamp()-(#{pendingSeconds} * interval '1 second')) or (r.status in ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') and (l.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() or r.owner_id is distinct from l.owner_id or r.fence_token is distinct from l.fence_token)) ) for update of r skip locked
mapper.update: update integration_schema.job_run set status='FAILED',error_code=#{code},error_summary=#{summary}, finished_at=clock_timestamp(),next_retry_at=null where run_id=#{runId} and status='PENDING'
update integration_schema.job_run set status='SUCCEEDED',phase=case when phase='NO_NEW_WINDOW' then phase else 'COMPLETED' end, finished_at=clock_timestamp(),next_retry_at=null where run_id=#{runId}
update integration_schema.job_run set status='CANCELLED',finished_at=clock_timestamp() where run_id=#{runId} and owner_id=#{owner} and fence_token=#{token} and status='CANCEL_REQUESTED'
update integration_schema.job_run set phase=#{phase} where run_id=#{runId}
update integration_schema.job_run set target_watermark=#{end}, checkpoint_generation=#{generation},caught_up=false where run_id=#{runId}
update integration_schema.job_run set caught_up=true,phase='WINDOW_COMPLETE' where run_id=#{runId}
update integration_schema.job_run set caught_up=false,phase='NO_NEW_WINDOW' where run_id=#{runId}
